observations.author_reading: The current noun frame and a 2024 usage support le bienvenu as a welcome person; the frozen noun is distinct from the adjective and the greeting.
Personal service is literary/formal; the domestic-servant use is separately dated. Select the devoted-person use and retain formal register.
Exact ô is classified as an interjection. Wiktionnaire particule is a source taxonomy difference, not the letter noun or a substitution of oh.

The 2018 first-person campus account provides the emphatic Ô joie construction. Only the short construction is selected as support; the attributed article sentence remains unselected in the raw archive.
observations.original_work: La ZEP / Le Monde, campus account published 2018-10-22; source URL and bibliographic identity are retained at raw line 55. External prose rights are separate and no full quotation is proposed.

observations.author_reading: Historical definition and playful synonyms; newer partner examples include historical discussion, costume reenactment and theatrical address. The site says these examples are automatically selected and not reviewed by its editorial team. They do not establish the required everyday sense.

Separate historical title and ironic gallant-man senses. The ironic sense lacks the fixed Wiktionnaire vieilli label, leaving conflicting register evidence; it does not itself settle modern everyday eligibility.
